groupings.title: Official Frond Skills
groupings.description: The consumer set, for applications building on @frondruntime/*. These six are the supported install; they reference each other and are meant to be installed together.

groupings.title: Repository Maintainer Skills (not for consumers)
groupings.description: Internal workflows for developing the Frond repository itself - Effect, Bun, release, refactoring, and monorepo policy. These are discoverable because the CLI scans .agents/skills, but they are not part of the official set and should not be installed into an application repository.
